question: Compare the warranties of both bids.
answer: Bid1 requires a minimum one‑year OEM warranty for student Chromebooks and a three‑year OEM warranty for student and staff Windows laptops, with all warranty service and repairs performed at no cost within five business days and the option for temporary replacements if repairs exceed that time. Bid2 offers a three‑year Dell limited hardware warranty (extended for all machines) with no additional service‑time details provided.
